verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Lambda lets you launch instances (API, docs) and lists available GPU types, but nothing describes a real-time capacity/availability view by type and region that a user can check before provisioning — docs only describe launch mechanics and pricing, not stock visibility. missing for 10: a documented capacity/availability API or dashboard showing per-region GPU stock before launch, and evidence that stockouts are surfaced proactively rather than discovered on launch failure.
